description: Deck-level aggregate: how well a deck converts ramp/draw resources into creature attacks. Used as anti-signal in score formulas to flag decks that are not actually attacking.
Deck-level state: deck contains zero (or near-zero) non-permanent spells (no instants or sorceries). Inverse signal — anti-pattern for spellslinger / cantrip-heavy themes.
Card-named archetype shorthand for a Birthing-Pod-style activated tutor-to-battlefield with sacrifice cost. Pod ladders 1->2->3->4->5->6 mana creatures.
Archetype shorthand for a deck built around many zero-mana-cost artifacts that trigger draw-on-cast effects. Storm-adjacent velocity engine.
Deck-level aggregate: total count of clone effects in the deck. Used as anti-signal in clone-deck classification (e.g. anti-token-swarm cross-check).
Deck-level state: deck contains zero (or near-zero) creatures. Inverse signal — anti-pattern for token / aristocrats / pod themes.
Deck-level state: deck wins via creature-attack only (no noncreature finisher). Anti-signal for extra-combat themes that double-count an existing combat plan.
Archetype label: control deck whose primary win plan leans on exile-based interaction (rather than counters or destruction).
Card-named archetype shorthand for a Field-of-the-Dead-style lands-matter token engine. Lands entering generate Zombie tokens at landfall thresholds.
Archetype label: reanimator deck. Mills/discards big targets and returns them via reanimation effects.
Archetype label: group-hug ramp variant — deck enables symmetric mana for all players (Howling Mine / Heartbeat-style) as part of a group-hug game plan.
Archetype label: deck wins via global life pressure (group-slug). Symmetric or asymmetric life loss across the table.
Card-named archetype shorthand for a Hardened-Scales-style +1/+1-counter doubling engine. Each counter placed becomes one extra; explosive over time.
Deck-level aggregate: count of hatebear-shaped creatures (Thalia / Aven Mindcensor / Glowrider style). Optional booster signal for hatebear themes.
Archetype label: hatebear creatures that strap on protection passively (Aven-Mindcensor + protection layers). Composite of static rule pressure + creature-shaped resilience.
Deck-level aggregate: total interaction count across removal types. Used as anti-signal in control-theme classification (low total disqualifies despite other markers).
Archetype label: lands-matter deck where lands are the engine (not just ramp). Multi-land-drop, lands-from-graveyard, landfall payoffs.
Card-named archetype shorthand for the Narset-Parter-of-Veils + Wheels lock pattern. Narset's static caps opponents to one draw per turn; wheels then strip their hands.
Card-named archetype shorthand for the Notion-Thief + draw-replacement pattern. Notion Thief redirects opponent draws to controller; pairs with wheels and draw triggers.
Card-named archetype shorthand for a Panharmonicon-style ETB-trigger doubler. Doubles the value of every ETB ability the controller would trigger.
Archetype label: pillowfort deck. Taxes attacks against the controller; punishes targeting; survives long enough to win via incidental engine.

Archetype label / strategy descriptor: deck leans on may-choose / opponent-choice mechanics for political negotiation (Council's Dilemma, Will-of-the-Council, vote effects, monarch-style swing votes).
Specialization of RESOURCE_DENIAL keyed to artifact targets. Anti-signal for affinity / artifact-storm themes (artifact-hate counters them).
Specialization of RESOURCE_DENIAL keyed to enchantment targets. Anti-signal for enchantress themes (enchantment-hate counters them).
Archetype label: spellslinger deck. Cast many cheap noncreature spells; reward each cast with a token / damage / draw trigger.
Specialized stax pattern: stops or punishes treasure-token sacrifice. Anti-signal for treasure-engine themes.
Archetype label: storm deck. Chains cheap spells / mana rituals to build storm count and resolve a payoff that scales on the count.
Mechanic pattern: card grants additional resources (mana or cards) to all players symmetrically (Howling Mine / Heartbeat of Spring). Group-hug enabler.
Specialization: stax-tax composite. Stacks Thalia + Glowrider-style cost-tax effects to slow opponents while controller plays past them.
Specialization: card lets controller cast spells from opponents' hands or libraries (Praetor's Grasp / Bribery-style theft from a non-battlefield zone).
Archetype label: token deck. Produces many creature tokens; pumps them with anthems / populate / token-doublers; closes via go-wide combat.
